description: Losslessly optimize explicit PNG inputs without rewriting sources.

ancillary.description: preserve (default) copies metadata chunks and refuses sources whose chunks depend on the color layout; strip drops every ancillary chunk and lists them.

dryRun.description: Compute the full report and write nothing.

inputDir.description: Directory containing PNG files to optimize (up to 4096 PNGs). Mutually exclusive with inputPaths.

inputPaths.description: PNG files to optimize (1 to 256 explicit paths; no globs, no directories). Mutually exclusive with inputDir. Never written.

mode.description: auto (default) keeps the smallest exact encoding or the source; a named mode forces that encoding and fails with OPTIMIZE_MODE_NOT_EXACT when it cannot hold the pixels exactly.

outputDir.description: Existing directory receiving <input basename> for every input.

outputPath.description: Explicit .png output path; only with exactly one input.

recursive.description: When scanning inputDir, recursively include subdirectories (default false).

name: optimize_asset
